title: WikiPageDeletedPayload
description: wiki.page.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Wiki server/wiki/service.js sync, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks publicationEvent). Emitted when a page (or its whole space) was deleted, in the transaction of the change. For subscribers other than Search: canonical URL, publication state and Search-shaped indexability, never the body (Search gets that from wiki.index_document.*). Envelope: subject { type: page, id: pg_…, revision: <published revision, 0 if none> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor the person or service:wiki (scheduled and system changes).

canonical_url.description: null: the event carries a tombstone, which has no URL.

indexability.description: The last gate decision, or null when there is none.

visibility.description: Effective visibility (the page's, narrowed by its space's).
